title: Deterministic Root-Finding over Finite Fields with Elliptic Curves
summary: Finding the roots of a polynomial over a finite field $\mathbb F_q$ in deterministic polynomial time is a long-standing open problem. Classical deterministic methods work in the multiplicative group $\mathbb F_q^\times$ and are efficient only when $q-1$ is smooth, which is rarely the case. We propose a method that replaces $\mathbb F_q^\times$ by the groups of rational points of an elliptic curve $E$ and of its quadratic twist $\widetilde E$.
